verdict.rationale: Thoropass's marketing says it 'connects evidence, progress, and auditors in one place from kickoff to final report,' with every audit step in one platform. Evidence requests carry comments, attachments and status updates, and a unified Comments Inbox covers controls and evidence requests, which supports moving the auditor exchange off email. But no documentation describes a dedicated, permission-scoped auditor role or view, and the auditor-in-platform claim rests only on marketing copy. Missing for 10: a documented scoped auditor role or view of controls and evidence, a first-party auditor workflow guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration of auditors working in the platform.
